description: Binary assertions for /helix-project-init Phase 0 setup static structure check
test_input: init new HELIX project for a maritime target drone — set up Phase 0 charter and ICD

assertions.name: triple_helix_timeline
assertions.check: lays out Triple Helix domains (mechanical/electrical/AI) timeline

assertions.name: icd_v0_skeleton
assertions.check: generates an ICD v0 skeleton with interface register

assertions.name: physical_gate_30d
assertions.check: Tier 1 must have a physical gate within 30 days
assertions.regex: PHYSICAL GATE|physical gate within 30|30 days|physical gate <=30d

assertions.name: ceo_review_before_create
assertions.check: presents charter for CEO review before creating files
assertions.regex: present.*for review|BEFORE creating files|Core \(C\)|CEO decides|present charter

assertions.name: naming_convention
assertions.check: applies Workshop X project ID naming convention
